def calculator(expr):
    return eval(expr)

def plan_and_execute(task):
    plan = []
    if task.startswith("calc:"):
        expr = task.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
        plan.append(f"Parse expression: {expr}")
        print(f"[Plan] {plan[-1]}")
        plan.append("Evaluate the mathematical expression")
        print(f"[Plan] {plan[-1]}")
        result = calculator(expr)
        plan.append(f"Result: {result}")
        print(f"[Plan] {plan[-1]}")
    else:
        plan.append(f"Analyze task: {task}")
        print(f"[Plan] {plan[-1]}")
        plan.append("Execute task steps")
        print(f"[Plan] {plan[-1]}")
        result = f"Executed: {task}"
        plan.append("Complete")
        print(f"[Plan] {plan[-1]}")
    return {"task": task, "plan": plan, "result": result}
